presets.description: Resize and compress your photo for IBPS PO, Clerk, and SO applications to meet official requirements.
guidelines: Recent passport-style color photograph
Light-colored or white background
Face should be clearly visible with neutral expression
No caps, hats, or dark glasses
Religious headwear permitted if face is fully visible
presets.notes: Requirements apply to IBPS PO, Clerk, SO, and RRB PO/Clerk exams conducted by IBPS.

presets.description: Crop and compress your signature for IBPS applications to meet official 140×60 pixel requirements.
guidelines: Sign on plain white paper using black ink pen
Do NOT use capital letters
Ensure the signature is clear and not smudged
Crop tightly around the signature

presets.description: Crop and compress your signature for SSC CGL, CHSL, and GD applications.
guidelines: Sign on plain white paper using black ink pen
Signature should be clear and legible
Do NOT sign in all capital letters
Avoid miniature or blurry signatures
Approximate dimensions: 4.0 cm × 2.0 cm
presets.notes: SSC CGL 2026 uses live photo capture for the primary photograph. Signature still requires file upload. Requirements apply to CGL, CHSL, GD, JE, and other SSC exams.

presets.description: Resize your photo for UPSC Civil Services application to meet official requirements.
guidelines: Recent color photograph on white background
Face should cover approximately 75% of the photograph
Both ears should be visible
No caps, dark glasses, or head coverings (religious wear permitted)
Clear, sharp, well-lit image
presets.notes: Live photograph capture is also required during the application process.

presets.description: Prepare your triple signature image for UPSC Civil Services application.
guidelines: Sign THREE times vertically on a single sheet of plain white paper
Use black ink (ballpoint or gel pen)
Ensure adequate spacing between each signature
Scan all three signatures together as a single image
Image must be clear, sharp, and well-lit
presets.notes: UPSC requires a unique 'triple signature' format — three identical signatures stacked vertically.

presets.description: Resize and compress your photo for NEET UG application to meet NTA requirements.
guidelines: Recent passport-size color photograph on white background
80% of face (including ears) should be visible
Neutral expression, looking directly at camera
Candidate's name and date should be printed at bottom
No caps, goggles, or masks
Both passport size and postcard size photos needed
presets.notes: Both passport size (2.5cm × 3.5cm) and postcard size (4" × 6") photographs may be required.

presets.description: Compress your signature for NEET UG application to meet the 4–30 KB requirement.
guidelines: Sign on plain white paper using black ink pen
Use running handwriting — do not use capital letters
Signature should be clear and legible

presets.description: Resize and compress your photo for JEE Main application to meet NTA requirements.
guidelines: Recent color photograph on plain white background
Face should cover at least 80% of the photograph
Both ears clearly visible
No polaroid, computer-generated, or filtered photos
Spectacles allowed if used regularly

presets.description: Compress your signature for JEE Main application to meet the 10–100 KB requirement.
guidelines: Sign on plain white paper using black or blue ballpoint pen
Use running handwriting — do not use capital letters
Signature should be clear and legible
Approximate dimensions: 3.5 cm × 1.5 cm

presets.description: Resize and compress your photo for Railway Recruitment Board applications.
guidelines: Recent passport-size color photograph on white background
Both ears clearly visible, neutral expression
No caps, hats, or dark glasses
Photo should be clear and well-lit
presets.notes: Requirements vary by CEN (Centralized Employment Notice). Some recent recruitments use live photo capture. Always check the specific notification.

presets.description: Compress your signature for Railway Recruitment Board applications.
guidelines: Sign on plain white paper using black or dark blue ink
Running handwriting (cursive/joined letters) is mandatory
Do NOT sign in BLOCK or CAPITAL letters
Signature should be clear and not smudged
